an10.116:1.1: Atha kho Ajito paribbājako yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi;
an10.116:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho Ajito paribbājako Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an10.116:2.2: tena pañcamattāni cittaṭṭhānasatāni cintitāni, yehi aññatitthiyā upāraddhā 'va jānanti upāraddh' amhā' ti.
an10.116:3.4: yaṃ Bhagavā bhāseyya, Bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantī' ti.
an10.116:4.1: ‘Tena hi bhikkhave suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmī' ti.
an10.116:4.2: ‘Evaṃ bhante' ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an10.116:5.1: Idha bhikkhave ekacco adhammikena vādena adhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti. Tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti,
an10.116:5.2: tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti
an10.116:5.3: ‘paṇḍito vata bho paṇḍito vata bho' ti. 3.
an10.116:6.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco adhammikena vādena dhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti, tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti,
an10.116:6.2: tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti
an10.116:6.3: ‘paṇḍito vata bho paṇḍito vata bho' ti. 4.
an10.116:7.1: Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco adhammikena vādena dhammikañ ca vādaṃ adhammikañ ca vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti, tena ca adhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti,
an10.116:7.2: tena sā adhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti
an10.116:7.3: ‘paṇḍito vata bho paṇḍito vata bho' ti. 5. Idha pana bhikkhave ekacco dhammikena vādena adhammikaṃ vādaṃ abhiniggaṇhāti abhinippīḷeti, tena ca dhammikaṃ parisaṃ rañjeti, tena sā dhammikā parisā uccāsaddā mahāsaddā hoti ‘paṇḍito vata bho paṇḍito vata bho' ti. 6.
an10.116:8.1: Adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca,
an10.116:8.3: adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
an10.116:9.1: Katamo ca bhikkhave adhammo, katamo ca dhammo, katamo ca anattho, katamo ca attho? 7.
an10.116:9.4: ye ca micchādiṭṭhipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.116:9.5: sammādiṭṭhipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.116:11.3: ye ca micchāvimuttipaccayā aneke pāpakā akusalā dhammā sambhavanti, ayaṃ anattho,
an10.116:11.4: sammāvimuttipaccayā ca aneke kusalā dhammā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, ayaṃ attho.
an10.116:12.1: Adhammo ca bhikkhave veditabbo dhammo ca,
an10.116:12.3: adhammañ ca viditvā dhammañ ca, anatthañ ca viditvā atthañ ca, yathā dhammo yathā attho, tathā paṭipajjitabban ti
an10.116:12.4: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ, idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttan
